recipeIngredient: 1 liter full fat milk or cow’s milk
1 tsp corn flour or all purpose flour (maida)

itemListElement.text: Take milk in a wide pan and keep it to boil on medium-low flame.
itemListElement.name: Take milk in a wide pan and keep it to boil on medium-low flame.

itemListElement.text: When the milk comes to a boil switch off the gas.
itemListElement.name: When the milk comes to a boil switch off the gas.

itemListElement.text: Then add mixture of 2 tbsp water +3 tbsp lemon juice in milk. Stir continuously.
itemListElement.name: Then add mixture of 2 tbsp water +3 tbsp lemon juice in milk. Stir continuously.

itemListElement.text: Milk has curdled in 3-4 min then switch off the flame. The milk has curdled completely with the watery whey.
itemListElement.name: Milk has curdled in 3-4 min then switch off the flame. The milk has curdled completely with the watery whey.

itemListElement.text: Then place the muslin cloth on the strainer and pour the curdled milk.
itemListElement.name: Then place the muslin cloth on the strainer and pour the curdled milk.

itemListElement.text: Rinse the chenna with water to remove the lemony flavor.
itemListElement.name: Rinse the chenna with water to remove the lemony flavor.

itemListElement.text: Gather the muslin cloth from the sides and rinse chenna very well with running water. This brings down the temperature of chenna.
itemListElement.name: Gather the muslin cloth from the sides and rinse chenna very well with running water. This brings down the temperature of chenna.

itemListElement.text: Then Squeeze the muslin tightly to remove excess water from chenna.
itemListElement.name: Then Squeeze the muslin tightly to remove excess water from chenna.

itemListElement.text: Hang the chenna for about 30min.
itemListElement.name: Hang the chenna for about 30min.

itemListElement.text: After 30 min removes chenna from muslin cloth.
itemListElement.name: After 30 min removes chenna from muslin cloth.

itemListElement.text: Then begin to mash and knead chenna with the heels of your palms. Knead for 10 min.
itemListElement.name: Then begin to mash and knead chenna with the heels of your palms. Knead for 10 min.

itemListElement.text: After 10 min smooth and uniform texture of chenna without any grains. Do not knead chhena after it starts to release the fat or your hands are slightly greasy.
itemListElement.name: After 10 min smooth and uniform texture of chenna without any grains. Do not knead chhena after it starts to release the fat or your hands are slightly greasy.

itemListElement.text: Take some portions from the chenna and roll them between your palms and make a smooth and round ball.
itemListElement.name: Take some portions from the chenna and roll them between your palms and make a smooth and round ball.

itemListElement.text: Cover all balls with moist muslin cloth and keep aside.
itemListElement.name: Cover all balls with moist muslin cloth and keep aside.

itemListElement.text: In a wide bowl take 2 cup of sugar and 6 cups of water.
itemListElement.name: In a wide bowl take 2 cup of sugar and 6 cups of water.

itemListElement.text: Stir to dissolve the sugar syrup. The consistency of sugar syrup should be watery. Boil sugar syrup on high flame.
itemListElement.name: Stir to dissolve the sugar syrup. The consistency of sugar syrup should be watery. Boil sugar syrup on high flame.

itemListElement.text: Reserve some sugar syrup which will be used for cooking rasgulla and serving rasgulla.
itemListElement.name: Reserve some sugar syrup which will be used for cooking rasgulla and serving rasgulla.

itemListElement.text: Once sugar syrup is completely boiling at high flame, then drop rasgulla in it.
itemListElement.name: Once sugar syrup is completely boiling at high flame, then drop rasgulla in it.

itemListElement.text: Cover immediately with a lid and let the rasgulla cook on high flame 5 minutes.
itemListElement.name: Cover immediately with a lid and let the rasgulla cook on high flame 5 minutes.

itemListElement.text: After 5 minutes flip rasgulla and cook rasgulla for 5 min on medium-high heat.
itemListElement.name: After 5 minutes flip rasgulla and cook rasgulla for 5 min on medium-high heat.

itemListElement.text: Total 10 min remove the lid and continue to cook for 7 min on medium to low heat.
itemListElement.name: Total 10 min remove the lid and continue to cook for 7 min on medium to low heat.

itemListElement.text: Once the rasgulla is cooked, switch off the flame and cool it for 2-3 minutes.
itemListElement.name: Once the rasgulla is cooked, switch off the flame and cool it for 2-3 minutes.

itemListElement.text: Then add cooked rasgulla into cold water to retain its shape.
itemListElement.name: Then add cooked rasgulla into cold water to retain its shape.

itemListElement.text: After 2 minutes transfer rasgulla into the reserved sugar syrup.
itemListElement.name: After 2 minutes transfer rasgulla into the reserved sugar syrup.

itemListElement.text: Refrigerate rasgulla for 2 hrs before serving it.
itemListElement.name: Refrigerate rasgulla for 2 hrs before serving it.

itemListElement.text: Soft, spongy, and juicy rasgualla is ready to serve.
itemListElement.name: Soft, spongy, and juicy rasgualla is ready to serve.
